what_the_producer_asks_the_reviewer_to_a: The guard passes vacuously on an empty changed-path set, so a silently wrong diff base yields PASS rather than FAIL. A fixture reproduces the wrong-base failure, but the vacuous-pass case is still unguarded.

The guard reads path strings only. It cannot see a write that reaches outside the allowlist through a pre-existing symlink; only the manifest's symlink refusal covers that, and only inside the PO-03 subtree.
Every test in this Wave was written by the producer of the code it exercises. If the producer misunderstood a requirement, the tests encode that misunderstanding and still pass.
The five defects reported in this Wave were all found by the producer reviewing its own work, which is exactly the arrangement the producer/reviewer separation hypothesis says is unreliable.
The anti-fabrication tests check that recorded hashes and commit ids resolve. They cannot check that a prose claim is true.
decisions_requested_from_the_reviewer: Whether to scale beyond ten units via true isolated worktrees or cloud VMs, or to accept that ten genuine units carry more evidence than sixty-four manufactured ones.
Whether an observed-but-unselectable model satisfies the strongest-model control, or whether a runtime that exposes model selection is a precondition for that control.

Whether to open Wave B. The commission's gate reads zero false completion, zero result loss and zero path collision; all three were observed as zero, but across ten units with no independent acceptance.
producer_recommendation: Do not accept this Wave. Accept or reject the individual controls marked PASS on their own evidence, and treat the six NOT_YET controls as open work rather than as satisfied.
